import Mathlib.Tactic

-- A tiny finite bookkeeping lemma from Erdos Problem 689 residual-cover reduction.
-- If small hits plus supplied residual hits reach omega + max(0,2-omega), then coverage is at least 2.

theorem residual_two_cover_nat (omega large : Nat)
    (hlarge : large >= 2 - omega) : omega + large >= 2 := by
  omega_cases : omega < 2
  · exact Nat.add_le_add_left hlarge omega |>.trans_eq ?_
  · have h : 2 <= omega := Nat.le_of_not_gt omega_cases
    exact le_trans h (Nat.le_add_right omega large)
